usage.outputShape: body.image_url (hosted JPG URL), body.image_description, body.metadata.model, body.metadata.aspect_ratio
usage.guide: POST a JSON body with a single "prompt" field describing the image you want to api.xona-agent.com/base-main/image/flux-2-flex. Payment is x402 USDC on Base ($0.06/call, no API key). The response is synchronous JSON: read the generated image from body.image_url (a hosted JPG you can download or display). Default aspect ratio is 1:1.
